about: The layers of a design system, in the order the guide visits them. One list: the guide, the ledger and the audit all use these ids. A layer is the artifact its decisions constrain. `title` and every choice `name` are terms from vocabulary.json. A layer with `built: false` is announced in one line and skipped. A choice may say under `sourced` that it also takes a row of the sources ledger: `kind` is the kind of source, `prefix` what the value starts with before the row's id, and `says` what such a value means. A choice may say under `asked_by` the question of the table of colour roles it answers: it is given once the owner's word for that question is `formula`, and not before. A choice with `many` takes a list of its options, and `always` the options every list holds.

options.application: People work in the screens: data-dense, task after task.
options.content-site: People mostly read: marketing, documentation, editorial.

options.AA: The level most products commit to and most laws ask for.
options.AAA: Stricter contrast. Fewer colours qualify as a primary.

options.standard: Keep the floor's type scale: the sizes every Tailwind user already knows.
options.modular: Derive every size from text-base and one ratio, so the steps are related.

options.minor-second: 1.067: steps barely differ. Dense screens with little hierarchy.
options.major-second: 1.125: gentle steps. Applications with many levels of heading.
options.minor-third: 1.2: clear steps that still fit a working screen.
options.major-third: 1.25: strong steps. Content sites with few heading levels.

options.4px: The floor's unit. In this floor the same unit also sizes controls, so changing it would resize every component: that is density, not spacing.

options.floor: The floor's own font, which its stylesheet already names and loads.
options.system: The font each device uses for its own interface: no file to load, and it looks a little different on every system.

sourced.says: A font with its row in the sources ledger, its pin and its licence: the value is `source:` and the row's id, and it can be chosen once a person has written the licence.

options.text: The same typeface as running text.
options.floor: The floor's own heading font, as its stylesheet names it.
options.system: The font each device uses for its own interface: no file to load.

sourced.says: A font with its row in the sources ledger, its pin and its licence: the value is `source:` and the row's id, and it can be chosen once a person has written the licence.

options.grey: Pure grey, the floor's own family: no screen changes hue, and a text colour moves only where its contrast needs it.
options.tinted: Grey leaning to the source colour: every neutral surface and text takes a little of its hue, so the whole interface follows the owner's colour.

options.error: Something failed, or an action cannot be taken back: the floor's destructive role. Always taken.
options.success: Something a person asked for is done.
options.warning: Something needs attention before it becomes a fault.
options.information: Something a person should know, with nothing wrong.

options.beside: The record opens in a pane beside the list where both fit, from 1024px; below that it takes the list's place.
options.over: The record opens in a side sheet over the list, as a dialog: the list stays as it was behind it.
options.in-place: The record takes the list's place at every width, and Back returns to the list.
